title: Ledrix CRM Audit — Admin & Seller (10 min)
note: Subtitles only — original voiceover from CRM Audit.mp4 is preserved.
lines: Welcome to the Ledrix CRM SaaS V1 launch audit.
This walkthrough covers the Admin and Seller workspaces on ledrix.co.
Part one — Admin panel. Sign in to manage your entire agency workspace.
The Admin dashboard gives you a real-time view of leads, orders, and team activity.
Every tenant is isolated — your brands, sellers, and client data stay secure.
In Leads, capture inbound prospects and assign them to the right seller instantly.
Open any lead to see status, assignment history, and next actions in one place.
Orders connect every deal to payment status — no more switching between tools.
Track the full funnel from first contact through closed and paid.
The Clients section lists every customer in your workspace with clear access control.
Manage Sellers — add team members, set roles, and monitor performance.
Brands let multi-brand agencies run separate pipelines under one tenant.
Payments and brand payouts give finance visibility tied directly to CRM records.
Account keys and domain scripts connect your intake forms and webhooks.
Part two — Seller portal. Built for closers who need focus, not admin clutter.
The Seller dashboard shows your personal pipeline and performance at a glance.
Assigned Leads — work your queue and update status as deals progress.
Orders — convert leads to paid clients with payment links and milestones.
Clients and Briefs keep customer context next to every deal you are closing.
Brand and payout views help sellers see earnings without leaving the CRM.
Ledrix connects admin oversight with seller execution in one platform.
That completes the Ledrix CRM V1 audit — Admin and Seller.
Start your free trial at ledrix.co — no credit card required.
